marketing_measurements.scope: third-party public website measurement; not verified app tokens

patterns.documented_behavior: Close/open via arrow and shortcut; drag divider; double-click resets default width; search filters while typing.
patterns.proposed_validation: Record default/min/max widths at runtime, pointer capture, keyboard resize alternative, reset, collapsed/focus/touch.

patterns.documented_behavior: View type icon can be overridden through searchable picker; persists for viewers, favorites and templates; clear restores default.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test fallback, shared settings, icon-only accessible name and consistency across surfaces.

patterns.documented_behavior: Sans/serif/mono, three sizes, default/full width, apply typography to all pages, optional header metadata, relationships dialog or accordion, sticky outline.
patterns.proposed_validation: Separate per-page from document settings; test text zoom, persistence, reading width, mobile and semantic headings.

patterns.documented_behavior: Block focus dims other content while typing; page focus hides sidebars during typing.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test keyboard, reading/typing transition, contrast of dimmed content, reduced motion and restoring panels.

patterns.documented_behavior: Wrap text, property icons, breadcrumb, parent names, hide tags, empty statuses, collapsed/expanded/flat subtasks and hide header.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test keyboard discoverability, search/filter semantics, overflow, long titles, layout shift.

patterns.documented_behavior: Selection bounding box, resize/rotate, endpoint snapping, visible connectors, minimap, keyboard pan and move.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test zoom coordinate mapping, endpoint drag, undo, keyboard, focus, touch and disconnected states.

patterns.documented_behavior: Whiteboard preferences include reduced motion enabled by default, alignment guides, edge scrolling and grid toggles. Scope is Whiteboard only.
patterns.proposed_validation: Measure actual timing with recording; test OS reduced motion, interruption, scroll and non-motion feedback.

patterns.documented_behavior: Desktop global command bar, configurable hotkey, local clipboard history (screenshot history Mac only), browser-to-app redirect preference.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test launch, foreground focus restore, consent, cross-platform conflicts, privacy and offline failure.

patterns.documented_behavior: Third-party text description identifies status-change toast with undo and close.
patterns.proposed_validation: Inspect screenshot and test undo availability, expiration, competing operations, accessible live region.

patterns.documented_behavior: Third-party description identifies empty folder illustration, explanation and create-list CTA.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test distinction between truly empty, filtered empty, permission failure and loading; CTA relevance.
